question: What do all mapped Fig4C-D/6C-F workbook ARG1/IL6 protein and qPCR marginals show for the prespecified source comparisons?
decision: Qualify directions and source contexts alongside R1 without treating unlinked RNA/protein preparations as a matched experiment.
strongest_rival: Source graph/workbook discrepancy, unknown preparation/donor/animal identity, differing assays and supplied normalization may explain apparent agreement or disagreement.
discriminator: Reconstruct every mapped workbook value with exact coordinate, condition and endpoint; separately flag 4C plot amplitude discrepancy, missing interaction arms and unknown pairing.
exposure_record: All selected workbook values, PDF panels and old R1 results were exposed during qualification. X0 mapped cells and blanks before this numerical freeze. No new X2 group summaries yet computed.
biological_unit: Panel-specific: reported mouse or biological preparation; human 6F observations have unknown donor independence. Source rows are observations, not inferred donor pairs.
nesting_and_overlap: Published panels are reused source data; row order does not establish pairing. No mapped animal/preparation/donor joins across assays or to R1.
population_and_selection: All numeric observations in the mapped rectangles for sheets4c,4d,6c,6d,6e,6f, grouped exactly by final figure labels and workbook map.
contrast: Nine assay/compartment panels with 16 prespecified target-minus-reference comparisons in x2_spec_v1.json; only supplied arms.
endpoint: ARG1 medium/lysate concentration; macrophage-count-normalized BAL ARG1; sorted-cell Arg1/Gapdh qPCR; IL6 medium concentration; BAL IL6 relative to uninjured; human P2RX4/18S qPCR.
methods: NumPy n, means, sample SD, min/max and unpaired differences from X0 mapped source CSV. Independent direct workbook OOXML and Decimal45 arithmetic verifies all source cells, blanks and numerical outputs.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain all source values including qPCR zero, structural blanks and unequal group tails. Missing KO untreated, KO uninjured and KD unstimulated arms remain missing; no inferred pairing. 4C eligible only as workbook-value reconstruction; exact graph reproduction held.
multiplicity: All supplied groups and prespecified comparisons shown; no hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, SEM-based inference or result selection.
precision_basis: Source-marginal descriptions do not justify a population interval; preparation/donor IDs and pairing are unresolved.
interpretation_limit: Protein accumulation is not secretion rate or metabolic flux; transcript measurements and normalization retain their own meaning. 4C workbook/graph amplitude mismatch unresolved; 6E is relative normalization, not absolute recovered pg/mL.
stop_rule: Stop after mapped source descriptions, figures and independent arithmetic. No imputed arm, figure digitization adjustment, matching to RNA, mediation or external expression extraction.
amendment_reason: New owner-authorized extension. Original analysis unchanged.
